invariants: 24 actual original/native loopback adapter observations compare every captured HTTP request, streamed chunk, extension acceptance and error name/message/failure/code/status/retry-after/request-id value.

Every field/value is retained without prose filtering or identity mapping. Only semantically identical JSON whole-number token spellings2000/2000.0 share a canonical digest; raw reports remain unchanged. Actual lone surrogates survive JSON serialization.
Malformed SSE diagnostics contain the first120 UTF16 units of the actual payload, including split/full surrogate controls.
Idle watchdog diagnostics include configured milliseconds using Source number rendering for integer, whole-float and fractional values.
Fresh unchanged pinned Source/Node22.22.2, selected/extracted ownPython3.8.10 and actual native imported module bytes are mandatory.
identity: Fixture24 names/order are exact; HTTP authorization/user/session/compaction headers, all body/chunk/error/failure values and extension acceptance are retained. Flattened status/retry-after/request-id are observed from the complete actual failure object on both sides, not extra language exception properties.
ownership: Source actual adapter is constructed with controlled public dependency inputs; native actual adapter uses a scoped Context/API-extension registry and owns stream/server cleanup. No product algorithm is copied into the observer.
ordering: Each local request completes or aborts before the next fixture; captured partial chunks and acceptance remain visible even when an error follows.
errors: Unexpected error classes fail the observer. Complete row mutations, omissions/duplicates and Source/module/interpreter changes reject receipts.
cancellation: Caller cancellation and configured per-read idle watchdog use actual adapter paths; arbitrary races/late callbacks/consumer closure remain outside this bounded contract.
adaptation: Python SSE preview explicitly slices UTF16 code units and idle configuration interpolates through existing Cordis JS String. Digests use existing lossless JSON snapshot to canonicalize only whole numeric token spellings; comparison retains decoded JSON values without platform traceback/cause-stack or extra language exception-property claims.
open_questions: Retry orchestration/full AgentLoop/profile boot, arbitrary malformed graphs/transport/cancellation schedules, images/files and full B2/B3 remain unqualified.
Static Source guards are not complete dynamic import closure; wider frozen full-gate inputs are still required. OAuth/cloud/paid API and realWin7 remain separately open.
